text:
sarah.peopleops: Quick pre-arrival check for candidate Liu (Senior Infra). Landing Wed 10:05am, interview loop 11:30–16:00. Need: lobby badge, parking, loaner Mac, dietary notes, and a clear arrival email.
sarah.peopleops: TL;DR — can folks confirm ownership: badge (jess), loaner (mike), welcome email + travel stipend (tom), panel late-join backup (elena).
tom.recruiter: I sent candidate travel confirmation earlier. @sarah.peopleops — she requested a quiet room for a coding whiteboard. Also vegetarian lunch.
mike.it: We have one M2 loaner left. Do you need a laptop imaged or just blank w/ Wi-Fi? If imaged, need 24h.
sarah.peopleops: Ideally imaged with Zoom + vscode + corp VPN. Candidate prefers macOS. Is 24h a hard constraint?
mike.it: 24h for full imaging. I can *reserve* the M2 and drop a pre-config with minimal apps (Zoom + browser) in 6h if that's ok. Encrypted disk and user account will be ready.
jess-ops: I'll own the lobby badge printing and parking QR. Where should candidate park? We have the visitor lot (Lot B) — I'll send QR and map.
elena.hiringmgr: Panelists: 11:30 intro (me, ryan, nadia), 13:00 deep dive (infra), 14:30 system design, 15:30 wrap. If any panelist is remote, set Zoom link and backup dial-in.
sarah.peopleops: @recruit-bot any flight updates?
recruit-bot: Candidate Liu — UA412 arriving 10:05, status: on-time. Seat: 12A. Luggage: 1 checked.
tom.recruiter: I can draft the arrival email. Need exact building address, parking code, contact phone, and the QR for badge pickup. Also reimbursement instructions (Concur link).
jess-ops: Building: 220 Red Pine Ave, 4th floor lobby. Parking Lot B gate code: 7192#. Welcome desk phone: +1-555-0134. I'll attach a map in the email thread.
sarah.peopleops: For reimbursement: please ask candidate to submit travel receipts to travel@redwood.com and we'll process via Concur within 5 business days. Tell them to keep boarding pass.
mike.it: Note for imaging: we must enroll loaner in MDM before handing it over. Candidate will sign loaner agreement form at welcome desk. Jess — can you have a tablet or paper copy ready?
jess-ops: Yep — loaner form + NDA + receipt for stipend printed. Also arranging a small snack basket with GF/DF options.
elena.hiringmgr: For remote panelists — @tom.recruiter set the Zoom meeting and include breakglass link. If host can't start, panelist Ryan (ryan@) can start.
tom.recruiter: Will do. Drafting arrival email now. Proposed content: 1) Arrival logistics, 2) Parking + QR, 3) Badge pickup + host phone, 4) Loaner laptop note + imaging, 5) Lunch dietary, 6) Reimbursement link. Want me to cc the hiring panel?
sarah.peopleops: CC the hiring panel but do not include interview questions. Keep it logistics only. Also add a note about building security: valid ID required.
tom.recruiter: Got it. Sending email in 10.
sarah.peopleops: One more — if candidate flight delayed >45m, offer remote interview option for first slot and reschedule on-site exercises. @elena, ok to run remote whiteboard if needed?
elena.hiringmgr: Yes, we can run the first session remote (Miro + Zoom) and move the in-person system design to the afternoon or next day.
mike.it: If we go remote, loaner imaging is moot. We'll still prepare the laptop at the desk in case.
recruit-bot: Reminder set — print badge & forms 2 hours before arrival.
sarah.peopleops: Perfect. Thanks all. Tom — paste the final arrival email back here once sent so I can note it in the candidate file. :thumbsup:
